en.title: Superman Star Edi Gathegi Joins Miami Vice '85' Crime Thriller
en.summary: Edi Gathegi, fresh off his impactful role as Mr. Terrific in James Gunn's 'Superman,' is heading to the neon-drenched streets of the 1980s. He's been cast in a significant part for Joseph Kosinski's upcoming 'Miami Vice '85' film.
en.body:
The stylish world of **Joseph Kosinski**'s **Miami Vice ’85** is getting a significant new player. **Edi Gathegi**, who recently impressed audiences as the ambitious Mr. Terrific in **James Gunn**'s **Superman**, has been tapped for a key role in the highly anticipated film. According to exclusive reports, Gathegi will embody a small-time crook whose considerable ambitions lead him into a situation far over his head, a character poised to make a substantial impact on the narrative.

This marks another exciting step for Gathegi, whose career has seen him navigate diverse and memorable roles. His involvement in **Miami Vice ’85** suggests a character with depth and complexity, fitting perfectly within the gritty yet glamorous aesthetic the film aims to capture. The project, set to be released by Universal Pictures on May 19, 2028, is being filmed for IMAX, promising a visually stunning experience that will transport viewers directly into the heart of its crime-thriller narrative. Production is slated to begin in November, with filming locations including both New York and Miami, aiming to recreate the iconic atmosphere of the original series.

## A Cast of Rising Stars and Established Talent

The ensemble for **Miami Vice ’85** is shaping up to be a formidable one. Gathegi joins a roster that already includes **Michael B. Jordan** and **Austin Butler** in leading roles, alongside **Alden Ehrenreich**, **Whitney Peak**, **Camila Morrone**, **Danny Ramirez**, and **John Leguizamo**. The inclusion of Gathegi, known for bringing intensity and charisma to his characters, further fuels anticipation for the film. His portrayal of a crook with big dreams and even bigger problems is sure to add a crucial dynamic to the unfolding plot, potentially serving as a catalyst for the main characters' journeys.

## The Allure of the Vice Reboot

Fans of the original **Miami Vice** television series, which originally aired from 1984 to 1989, have long hoped for a cinematic revival that captures its groundbreaking style and substance. **Joseph Kosinski**, known for his visually arresting work on films like **Top Gun: Maverick**, appears to be channeling that iconic 80s vibe for this adaptation. The choice to film for IMAX and the meticulous casting, including Gathegi’s intriguing character, suggest a commitment to delivering a high-octane, visually spectacular crime drama that honors the legacy of the source material while forging its own identity. The film is produced by **Dylan Clark** via his Dylan Clark Productions.

## What's Next

With production commencing in November, more details about **Miami Vice ’85** and the specific roles of its star-studded cast are expected to emerge. Fans can look forward to seeing **Edi Gathegi** in this pivotal role when the film hits theaters on May 19, 2028.

content_raw: Michael B. Jordan and Austin Butler are starring in the adaptation of the stylish 1980s TV series.
